title.ja: 図1-1 向かい飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Opposing Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1は向かい飛車の基本形です。飛車を8筋に振るのが向かい飛車の駒組みです。また、左の金を囲いにくっつけず7八に上げるのも特徴で、飛車交換に強い陣形になっています。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 shows the basic Opposing Rook formation. The rook is swung to the 8th file. Another feature is that the left gold goes up to 7八 instead of sticking to the castle, making the formation strong against a rook exchange.

explain.ja: ここからは初手から向かい飛車の駒組みを見ていきます。まずこちらが角道を開け、相手も角道を開けてきたところで、▲6六歩と突いて角交換を防ぎます。角交換を避けて駒組みを進めるのは振り飛車の特徴です。
explain.en: From here we look at the Opposing Rook buildup from the first move. First open the bishop's diagonal, and when the opponent opens his as well, play ▲6六歩 to prevent a bishop exchange. Avoiding the bishop exchange while building is characteristic of Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 振り飛車らしく、角道を止める
section.en: Block the bishop's diagonal, as befits Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図2-2 角を▲7七角と上がる
title.en: Figure 2-2: Move the bishop up to ▲7七角

explain.ja: 向かい飛車に振るには、8八に角がいると邪魔になります。角を▲7七角と上げて、8筋に飛車を振る空間を空けましょう。
explain.en: To swing to Opposing Rook, a bishop on 8八 gets in the way. Move the bishop up with ▲7七角 to clear space for the rook on the 8th file.

title.ja: 図2-3 飛車を8筋に振る
title.en: Figure 2-3: Swing the rook to the 8th file

explain.ja: ▲8八飛と飛車を8筋に振れば、向かい飛車の陣形が完成です。銀を6七に上げておくのもポイントで、角の頭を守る意味があります。
explain.en: Swinging the rook to the 8th file with ▲8八飛 completes the Opposing Rook formation. Raising the silver to 6七 is also important, as it protects the head of the bishop.

section.en: Swing the rook to the eighth file

title.ja: 図3-1 片美濃囲いにするのが基本

explain.ja: 向かい飛車では、片美濃囲いを組むのが基本です。玉を2八まで動かし、銀を上げれば囲いの完成です。他の振り飛車でも、美濃囲い系の陣形にするのが基本です。
explain.en: In Opposing Rook, the basic castle is the half Mino castle. Move the king to 2八 and raise the silver to complete it. In other Ranging Rook openings too, a Mino-type castle is the standard.

section.ja: 片美濃囲いにするのが基本
section.en: Building a Half Mino castle is the basic approach

line.text: △3二玉、▲4八玉、△5二金右、▲3八玉、△5四歩、▲2八玉、△5三銀、▲3八銀、△1四歩、▲1六歩

title.ja: 図3-2 金を左に上がる

explain.ja: 左側の金は、囲いにくっつけず▲7八金と左側に上げるのが向かい飛車の駒組みの特徴です。この手は自陣に飛車を打たれる隙をなくし、飛車交換の展開に強くする狙いがあります。
explain.en: Raising the left gold to ▲7八金 on the left side, rather than attaching it to the castle, is characteristic of Opposing Rook. It removes any weakness where a rook could be dropped in Black's camp and strengthens Black in games with a rook exchange.

section.en: Use gold on the left side
